# Security policy

## Status

This repository is a prototype. There is no deployment: no hosted instance, no production environment and no user data. See "Not deployed today" in [the architecture doc](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Supported versions

Only `main` is supported.

## How to report a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting ("Report a vulnerability" on the repository's Security tab). Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

## Leaked credentials

This repo is public and history is permanent (see the repo rules in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)). If a key or token is ever committed, it will be revoked and rotated. Public history cannot be un-published, so rotation is the real fix.
